accepted_conclusion_text.decision: On a fixed pipeline, positive coordinate rescaling preserves the native sign representation exactly while raising retrieval score after full orthogonal mixing. The LoCoMo computation reproduced numerically from verified raw data across 92,100 question/seed/arm records. Denominator instability in the block-normalised comparisons, together with preregistration aggregation and interpretation inconsistencies, limits any comparative mechanism inference. Post-hoc sensitivity analyses do not repair that limit; they make it visible. This is not a general mechanism result, not a production claim, and does not generalise to other encoders or corpora.
